name: Exterior Porch Floor RP Prime
intent: RP primer — spot prime (FAIR), full prime (POOR), bonding primer (unknown coating). GOOD skips prime. QT2 GOOD also skips. Same QT-to-coating mapping as NC for product selection.
doctrine: RP prime. Spot prime on FAIR (bare patches from failing). Full prime on POOR (>30% bare from peeling). Bonding primer for unknown/incompatible existing coatings. GOOD condition skips prime. Steps brush-only when priming needed.
